QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Prepare the Memory Chip
QuestInfo.0: What does #b#p2153000##k have to say? Go find out.
QuestInfo.1: #p2153000#, one of the Black Wing managers, says he'll sell you his #b#t1003134##k. With his hat, the gatekeepers will surely let you in. All you have to do is give him the dough--#b30 Patrol Robot S Memory Chips#k, to be specific.
QuestInfo.2: You received the #t1003134#. #p2153000#, laughing, said he'll sell you another if you ever need it. He really is an unpleasant man, but at least you can enter the mine now.

0.0: I knew you would react like that. Heheh... Get me #bPatrol Robot S Memory Chip#k x#r30#k from #rPatrol Robot S#k nearby. It's also my job to collect the voice recorded in the chip. Just think of the hat as compensation for doing my job for me.
0.1: Of course it's fine. Black Wing management doesn't care who's doing the manual labor around here as long as it gets done. You collect the stuff, I get a break, and you get the hat, okay? Relax. We're killing two birds with one stone.

yes.0: Talk to me again when you have the item ready. I'll be waiting.

1.0: Did you bring the goods? Ah, great. Here's the hat. Talk to me again later.

default.0: What? You don't have #bPatrol Robot S Memory Chip#k x#r30#k yet? Geez, guess I picked the wrong customer. Don't you want to enter the mine?
